sql: SELECT i.iban_hash AS inv_hash, i.iban_last4 AS inv_last4, v.iban_hash AS master_hash, v.iban_last4 AS master_last4, v.bank_since FROM lightning.metastore.humankey.northwind.invoices i JOIN lightning.metastore.humankey.northwind.vendors v ON v.vendor_id = i.vendor_id WHERE i.invoice_id = 'INV0005'
